purpose: Evaluate EPROLO product eligibility independently for each destination market instead of using Israel-only truth.

states.SHIPPING_DISCOVERY_PASS: Supplier currently returns an acceptable destination quote; not sufficient for sale.
states.PRODUCT_MARKET_SHADOW_PASS: Product truth and destination shipping pass; legal/profit/live gates may still block.
states.MARKET_POLICY_HOLD: Supplier shipping may pass, but the destination is not yet mapped/approved for HUNT real-money launch.
states.PROFIT_HOLD: Final provider order-cost/profit evidence is not verified.
states.LIVE_ELIGIBLE: Reserved for all hard gates PASS plus Owner Gate; currently no EPROLO product has this state.

global_rules: Never infer worldwide availability from one destination quote.
A product may be eligible in one country and blocked in another.
EU policy mapping does not imply equal shipping economics; each EU destination is quoted separately.
Unmapped markets may be researched in SHADOW but remain unavailable for real-money checkout.
Market legal readiness and supplier shipping readiness are separate gates.
Final profit remains blocked until the EPROLO order-cost API mismatch is resolved.
